title: Lumpcode featureBacklog item (desc.yml)
description: Schema for backlogItems/todo|completed/<name>/desc.yml used by the `featureBacklog` recipe. `workflow` lists stages. `manualReq` in workflow is a gate (wait for requirements.md), not an agent context. If both `req` and `manualReq` are listed, `manualReq` wins (runtime warns). The boolean field `manualReq` is deprecated and ignored.

name.description: Item id. Must match the folder name. Must not end in _req, _testPlan, or _testImpl (those suffixes are reserved for context names).

task.description: What to do. Folded YAML (`>-`) is fine for multi-line text.

priority.description: Lower number runs sooner. Per lump, not global across lumps.

dependsOn.description: Other item names in this lump that must finish first. Tickets are prefixed with the parent name at runtime.

workflow.description: Stages for this item. Omit ≡ [req, testPlan, testImpl] then impl. req: lump writes requirements.md. manualReq: wait for a human requirements.md (no agent context). If both are listed, manualReq wins. testPlan / testImpl run on feature/<name>. impl is the default terminal if neither impl nor directImpl is listed. directImpl may implement without requirements.md.

manual.description: When true, the item is skipped (no stages). Not inherited by tickets. Umbrella completion still runs.

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp stamped when the item is moved to completed/. Do not set this by hand on todo items.
